faqReplacement.question: Can I use hotspot with a Philippines eSIM?
faqReplacement.expectedAnswer: Hotspot availability depends on the chosen plan, local network and device. Check the package details before purchase if tethering is important for your trip.
faqReplacement.answer: Yes. eSIM Go supports sharing your eSIM data through a personal hotspot on a compatible phone. Select the travel eSIM for mobile data, then enable hotspot in your phone settings. Connected devices use the same data allowance. If hotspot does not work, follow the installation guidance or contact DALO support.
